title: rp-a.test asks for RP ID "rp-a.test." with a trailing dot

unsafe.definition: a credential stored under "rp-a.test." or one whose rpIdHash is over a string other than the RP ID the page passed

note: HTML registrable-suffix algorithm: the host parser keeps the trailing dot, "rp-a.test." != "rp-a.test" and ".rp-a.test." is not at its end -> false -> SecurityError (L3 §5.1.3 step 7). UNCERTAIN: engines that strip FQDN dots would accept.
